index.html.summary: 2D Game Template A 2D game template for Visual Studio built for Mohawk College's GAME 10003 Game Development Foundations course with the goal to a beginner-friendly 2D game programming environment. Template File See the GitHub Releases page for up-to-date templates. API Reference How do you code using the library? View the MohawkGame2D API Reference. The content provided in MyCanvas discusses some of this code in more detail.
